guildInfo.about: Kaizen is a chill but serious Horde raiding guild pushing into 25-man progression content on TBC Classic. We're building a solid, consistent roster of players who show up prepared, respect each other's time, and want to actually clear content — without the toxicity. If that sounds like you, come hang.
guildInfo.recruitment:
We are actively building our 25-man roster and looking for reliable, raid-ready players.

Current loot system:
2 Soft Reserves · MS > OS + 1

All specs considered — reach out on Discord if you're interested in running with us.
guildInfo.lootRules:
2 Soft Reserves (SR) — each raider may reserve up to 2 items per raid week.
MS > OS — main spec rolls beat off spec rolls on all items.
+1 Rule — once you win a main spec item, you go to the back of the line for subsequent drops that night.

tools.name: That's My BIS
tools.desc: Raiders pre-list their BIS items by priority. When loot drops, loot council can instantly see who has it highest on their list, making decisions fast and transparent. Sign up at thatsmybis.com with your Discord account.

tools.name: Gargul
tools.desc: In-game addon used by the loot master to manage rolls, track MS/OS, and distribute loot cleanly. Integrates directly with TMB. Install via CurseForge — only the loot master strictly needs it, but raiders benefit from having it too.

tools.name: Method Raid Tools
tools.desc: Essential raid leader addon. Tracks raid cooldowns, manages assignments, handles notes and reminders, and inspects raiders gear and specs. Required for officers, strongly recommended for all raiders. Install via CurseForge.

assigns.notes: Rodent tanks elementals on transition. Warlocks banish elementals on the last transition.

rows.valueA: Howiebling > MD Sobadai to start, stop DPS transitioning to Nature. Zuul > MD Bootboot, lust on nature transition, down adds. Repeat. Warlocks banish adds on final transition.

assigns.notes: CC adds on platforms, kill adds in middle first before helping with platforms.

rows.valueA: CC adds on platform, kill adds in the middle before helping with platforms. Ranged, go wild. No threat pull for you.

rows.valueB: Off the rip once tank establishes threat.

rows.valueA: Melee will stay in whirlwind of human phase, healers will heal through the damage. Ranged should jump during whirlwind to try to keep targets on melee.

assigns.notes: Kill Tidalvess first, Sharkkis second, then all ranged on Carbdis. Warlock Curse of Tongues on Carbdis + rogue to kick.

rows.valueA: Everyone on Tidalvess, kill totems fast. Then Sharkiss, then ranged will be on Caribdis. Melee stay on Fathom to kill totems.

assigns.notes: Healers RESIST the urge to heal raid damage. Heal after tanks have threat on Murlocs.

rows.valueA: Healers stack with Paladin to lure Murlocs into consec. Keishatini on water prison, DPS just do your thing.

assigns.lust_timing: Lust to clear mobs into P3 or at start of P3
assigns.notes: Sobadai, Totemy, and Bootboot will loot, pass, and dunk cores respectively.

rows.valueA: Grounding totem down at all times in tank group, static charge move away from raid.

assigns.lust_timing: Lust for add clean up end of P2 or at P3 start
assigns.notes: Sobadai, Totemy, and Bootboot are looting, passing, and dunking respectively. Oshika is kiting strider, all melee on Elites all ranged on Striders.

assigns.lust_timing: Lust on pull once tank establishes threat.
assigns.notes: Tanks move to platforms AHEAD of time. Drop down on Flame quill, use that time to kill adds.

rows.valueB: Off the rip once threat is established

rows.valueA: Kill adds during Flame Quill, Dive Bombs, and Start of P2. Rodent will mark adds to be burned.

assigns.notes: Start this phase by killing adds. Tanks taunt off each other when MELT ARMOR is applied. Spread for dive bomb, avoid flame patch.

rows.valueA: Avoid flame patch, kill adds during dive bomb (or when there are 3 or more)

assigns.notes: Pally can go healer here, Soba fight for threat, hunters avoid orbs, melee and ranged stack + healers raid heal.

rows.valueB: Off the rip when tank establishes threat.

rows.valueA: Tanks aggressively chase threat on main tank. You will take hatefuls. Hunters dodge orbs.

assigns.notes:
Wrath of Astromancer = Run out of raid pile
Interrupt casters + AOE them down
Hunters put snake trap down, Shamans drop totems, elementals, everything to bait Arcane Missile.

Healers TARGET OF TARGET for healing.

rows.valueA: Run out of raid pile if you have wrath of astromancer. Hunter MD at start of phase 2

assigns.notes:
Positioning fight:
Thaladred to back of the room
Sanguinar + Telonicus left side
Capernian right side.

Warlock tank = MAX range. Tank between ranged far enough to avoid conflag on group.

rows.valueA: This is simply a positioning fight to get the bodies where we need for phase 3. Ranged only on Capernian if you have increased range talents.

assigns.notes:
Pull Devastation out of the pack to the left
Face bow away from raid on the right
Tank Cosmic Infuser from Paladin
Paladin tank the rest in the middle and AOE them down.

rows.valueA: Pick up your weapons, you can do so as they go down.

assigns.notes: Same kill order, all ranged on Thaladred, melee on Sanguinar and Telonicus, last kill Capernian

rows.valueA: Pick up your weapons! Same kill order: Thaladred, Sanguinar/Telonicus, Capernian

assigns.lust_timing: Lust off the rip on this phase.
assigns.notes: GIVE TANK TIME TO GET AGGRO! Kick/Interrupt pyroblast, down KT shield, if Pyro goes off use shield. Daggers break MC, and Elemental Shaman kite Phoenix. On gravity lapse, don't touch the floor, don't take too much fall damage.

rows.valueB: Off the rip of this phase when tank gets threat!

rows.valueA: Grounding totems help here. Kick his spells, break barrier to kick pyroblast. During gravity lapse do NOT touch the floor.

assigns.lust_timing: Lust to clear adds at start of P3
assigns.notes: Warlocks + Hunters kill sporebats, everyone focus DPS, grounding totem needs to be down at all times by Shaman in tank group. Static charge, isolate.

rows.valueB: At phase transition to clean up adds

rows.valueA: Hunters kill sporebats, isolate if you have static charge, stay out of poison, paladins blessing of freedom on tanks, shamans grounding totem down!

Coilfang Hate-Screamer - Kill first in all packs, has silence

Underbog Colossus - Acid Geyser: Run to tank
Spore Quake: Run away from mob
Coilfang Priestess - Kill first, has an AOE heal/damage

Greyheart Tidecaller - Kill first, kill totems that spawn water elementals.

Greyheart Nether-Mage - Keep sheeped while killing them. Does AOE damage.

Greyheart Shield-Bearer - STACK on these guys, they will charge. Can be catastrophic if there are multiple.
Coilfang Fathom-Witch - Kill first, will MC. Best to CC your MC'd friends.

Astromancer - Kill first, does AOE blast wave. Purge Molten Armor.

Star Scryer - Keep/spam sheep, can MC and does AOE arcane damage.

Bloodwarder Legionnaire - Tank separate from group. Does Whirlwind.

Bloodwarder Marshal - Patrol pat, comes with squires. Does Whirlwind.

Crystalcore Sentinel - AOE Arcane damage. Does Overcharge. When this ability happens OT can taunt.

Crystalcore Devastator - Countercharge does reflect damage on auto attacks.

Crystalcore Mechanic - Banish. Saw blade does massive AOE +Bleed damage.

Tempest Smith - Keep/spam sheep. Does AOE bomb damage that reduces armor.
Nether Scryer - Kill first. MASS mind control. Must be tanked out of main room. CC your MC'd friends.

Crimson Hand Battle Mage - Kill first. Has 3 Mass AOE skills.

Crimson Hand Centurion - Keep/spam sheep. Arcane Flurry will kill everyone.
